user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Asteroid Mining Rig. A mining operation on a tumbling asteroid: a drill rig anchored with pitons boring a glowing bore hole, a tethered mining ship station-keeping nearby, floating ore containers on cables, floodlights raking the cratered surface, scattered regolith debris drifting, a small habitat pod with a lit window, and the pale sun and star field beyond. Style: industrial deep-space. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
